verdict.rationale: SigNoz has no in-platform AI investigator in the evidence. AI-driven investigation depends on external agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) connecting through its official MCP server and Agent Skills, which can query metrics, logs, traces and alerts in natural language. The documented AI use cases ('Investigate What Changed After a Deploy', 'Reconstruct a Bug from a Trace ID', 'Tune a Noisy Alert') come close to root-cause investigation, but only as titles. Missing for 10: a native platform AI that investigates alerts or errors, explicit root-cause proposal output, detailed docs of the investigation workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
